answer.rationale: The low-cost vendor is the only quoted option that meets the mandated 18% component-spend reduction, while the incumbent has refused to reopen pricing. I would verify the archived evidence that its onboarding and invoicing were reliable, then switch primary supply through a guarded test or staged allocation. The line is already at 94% of committed volume with no buffer, so capacity, delivery performance, and transition continuity remain material unverified risks; a second source would reduce those risks but may not achieve the required savings.
